title: Injera Bread
description: Traditional Ethiopian flatbread, often served with various stews and salads. Injera is made from teff flour.
instructions: Mix teff flour and baking powder together in a large bowl.
Gradually add water and mix until a smooth batter is formed.
Let the batter rest for 24 hours.
Place a small amount of the batter onto the preheated bake stone or baking sheet.
Spread the batter evenly into a thin circle.
Bake for 1-2 minutes or until the injera starts to bubble and the edges are slightly charred.
Remove from oven and let cool on a wire rack.
